infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LandConnect requires camera access for in-app video calls and live land plot walkthroughs.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LandConnect requires microphone access for in-app audio and video calls between buyers, sellers, and brokers.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LandConnect uses your location to geotag and discover nearby land listings.
